 class Author(Thing):
     """Class to represent /type/author objects in OL."""
 
+    def merge_remote_ids(self, incoming_ids: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[dict[str, str], int]:
+        """Return combined IDs and the number of incoming IDs already present.
+
+        Do not mutate the author when any identifier conflicts.
+        """
+        merged = dict(self.get('remote_ids') or {})
+        matches = 0
+        for kind, value in incoming_ids.items():

+                raise AuthorRemoteIdConflictError(
+                    f"Conflicting {kind} remote ID for author {self.key}: "
+                    f"{merged[kind]!r} != {value!r}"
+                )
+            if value and merged.get(kind) == value:
+                matches += 1
+            elif value:
+                merged[kind] = value
+        return merged, matches
